status: pre-registered before any detection code or run; not to be edited after the first scored run
hypothesis: H2 Hidden liabilities. Combining (a) loan and card accounts present in the grant, (b) recurring outflows to lenders identified by Enrich category, brand, BPAY biller code or reference, and (c) cadence detection will identify liabilities missing from the application with precision of at least 90% and recall of at least 80%, for applicants with at least 3 months of history, because repayments are regular in amount and timing and lenders are identifiable payees.

metric.unit: a liability: one (applicant, family, provider). Families: credit_card, loan (car_loan and personal_loan), bnpl, sacc, wage_advance
metric.detected_undisclosed: a liability the method finds that matches no declared liability of the same family and provider in the application
metric.true_positive: a detected-undisclosed liability that matches a ground-truth liability with declared = false, by family and normalised provider; each ground-truth liability is matched at most once
metric.false_positive: a detected-undisclosed liability that matches no undeclared ground-truth liability

classification.supported: primary run precision >= 0.90 and recall >= 0.80, with the negative control passing
classification.refuted: primary run precision < 0.80, with the negative control passing
classification.inconclusive: anything else: precision 0.80 to 0.90, or recall below 0.80 with precision at least 0.80, or the negative control fails, or the data cannot test the claim

data.population: all 380 applicants; every one has 3, 6 or 12 months of history, so all meet the hypothesis's 3-month floor

labelled_liabilities.source: ground truth truth.liabilities.items (counted before registration; no detection was run)

inspection_before_registration: Before registering, the narrative and field formats of set v1 were inspected (product names of card and loan accounts, and the most common narratives for the loan_repayment, bnpl, sacc_loan, wage_advance and transfer categories), and the ground-truth liabilities were counted. No detection was run and nothing was scored. The finding that shaped the method: card repayments by BPAY are categorised as transfer by Enrich (ENR-28), and their biller name names the card (for example 'NAB CREDIT CARD PAYMENT'), so step (b) uses the BPAY biller name.

categorisation.source: the committed cache research/enrich/synthetic-v1-categories.json: Moroku Enrich local engine 1.7.0, taxonomy 1.4, no dictionary, overrides or LLM cache, as in SIG-17
categorisation.deviation: the ticket's control is taxonomy 1.3; only the local engine at taxonomy 1.4 is available (the deployed Enrich, D27, is not built). Recorded in each run record
categorisation.brand: Enrich's output in the cache has no brand; the provider comes from the narrative, the BPAY biller name or the account's product name

method.window: every transaction in a shared transaction account up to as_of (the whole history the feed holds, at most 12 months)
method.a_accounts_in_grant: each account with productCategory CRED_AND_CHRG_CARDS is a credit_card liability; each PERS_LOANS account is a loan. Provider: the productName with a trailing 'Credit Card', 'car loan' or 'personal loan' removed. Found from the account alone, with no repayments needed

b_lender_outflows.by_bpay_biller: a debit with a BPAY biller name containing 'CREDIT CARD' is a credit_card repayment; provider = the biller name before 'CREDIT CARD'
b_lender_outflows.excluded: credits, and debits whose narrative carries a BSB and account number (own-account transfers, as in SIG-39 EQ-02)

method.provider_normalisation: upper case; digits removed; the words LOAN, REPAYMENT, REPAYMENTS, INSTALMENT, PAYMENT, CREDIT, CARD, PTY, LTD and BPAY removed; spaces collapsed. The same normalisation applies to ground truth and the application
method.c_recurrence: lender outflows are grouped by (family, normalised provider). A group is a liability when at least min_occurrences of its debits lie within amount_tolerance of the group's median amount, and the median gap between those debits falls in a cadence band: weekly 5 to 9 days, fortnightly 12 to 16, monthly 26 to 35
method.merge: a liability found by (a) and by (b) or (c) with the same family and provider is one liability
method.disclosure: a liability is disclosed when the application's declared_liabilities holds one with the same family (car_loan and personal_loan are both loan) and the same normalised provider
method.output: for each applicant, its detected-undisclosed liabilities, each with its evidence transaction IDs (empty for an account-only find)

negative_control.name: rotated declarations
negative_control.manipulation: each applicant is given the declared_liabilities of the next applicant in ID order (the last takes the first's); the transactions, accounts and categories are unchanged
negative_control.expected: precision below 0.50, because declared liabilities now read as undisclosed. If precision is 0.50 or more, the disclosure comparison is not what drives the result, and no other result in the set stands

miss_causes.note: every false negative and false positive in the primary run is tagged with one cause, in this order of precedence

false_negative.FN1 no visible repayment: no debit to the provider in any shared account, and its account is not in the grant (paid from an unshared account, or not yet due)
false_negative.FN2 not identified as a lender: debits to the provider exist but none is a lender outflow: category not a credit category and no BPAY card biller
false_negative.FN3 too few occurrences: lender outflows exist but fewer than min_occurrences in the window
false_negative.FN4 amount varies: enough occurrences, but fewer than min_occurrences within amount_tolerance of the median
false_negative.FN5 cadence: enough occurrences within tolerance, but the median gap is outside every cadence band

false_positive.FP1 declared liability not matched: the application declares it, but family or provider did not match
false_positive.FP2 not a liability: no ground-truth liability of that family and provider
false_positive.FP3 duplicate: a second detection of one ground-truth liability

tests.T1: a $450 monthly repayment to a named lender for 6 months, not in the application, is detected as undisclosed with those 6 transactions as evidence (LIA-01 amber in SIG-42)
tests.T2: the same repayment declared in the application is not undisclosed (LIA-01 green)
tests.T3: a monthly gym direct debit is not a liability
tests.T4: per D28, CI asserts that the primary run reproduces its recorded precision and recall from the committed inputs, not that they meet the targets

known_limits: set v1 has no mortgages, and no undisclosed car or personal loans: the undisclosed liabilities are cards (20), BNPL (15), SACC (18) and wage advances (16)
openfeed supplies no direct debits, scheduled payments or loan schedules, so detection rests on posted transactions and account lists only
set v1's narratives are generated from templates and every repayment names its lender plainly; real narratives are noisier, so this result is an upper bound on real performance
the categoriser is the local engine at taxonomy 1.4, not the deployed Enrich at 1.3
card repayments by BPAY are categorised as transfer (ENR-28); step (b) recovers them from the biller name only because set v1's billers say 'CREDIT CARD'
a liability paid from an account the applicant didn't share is invisible unless its own account is in the grant (FN1); set v1 does not model how often that happens in practice
